rules.execution: Generate and inspect one image at a time, but continue the approved batch without waiting between images.
rules.identity: Only clean mother art, clean source panels, or a deterministic crop/composite made from them may be used as identity references. Never use damaged green-fringed v02 sprites or edge-repair v03 sprites.
rules.composition: 16:9 cinematic visual-novel image with readable faces/hands and a calm lower edge for dialogue UI.

jobs.promptSummary: Foreground conductor hand catches the black-gold baton as luminous five-line staffs enter the wrist; exact transformed Atya waits amid score-moths in the ruined theater.
Academy choir stops beneath the half-beat clock tower as a translucent second voice appears only in the lead singer's cut-off tail note.
A failed awakening with a human silhouette and weak amber tuning-fork core peels from a blue-white crystal corridor while two travelers stop rather than attack.

Karon raises one baton beneath the colossal black train organ as empty seats, porcelain masks and spectral hands produce false applause.

jobs.promptSummary: Exact Atya and Sequence Four testify at separate lecterns before a packed White Score hearing chamber that has finally stopped writing and begun listening.
At a rain-dark roadside camp, Sequence Four offers an open hand and Anning answers with only her fingertips, an understated friendship promise.
Exact Atya and Milo study a wet route map marked with two broken pendant pairs before dawn.
Exact Atya moves closer beside a dying northern campfire and reaches toward the faceless protagonist without touching.
Exact Milo sits beside low embers and finally speaks while the faceless protagonist's hand rests nearby.
Character-free snowfield route toward a fortified pass, with resonance poles, brass wind chimes and a buried supply sled.
Low investigation view of doubled wagon ruts, sheltered boot prints, a retreat cord and one brass chime bead proving professional planning.
